mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, wr.Wr_Title as wrTitle, proc.C_Name as pConsName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, mn.* from OA_Project_Report mn left join OA_Work_Report wr on wr.Wr_Id = mn.Wr_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department where mn.P_Id = #{pId} and mn.Pr_Type=#{prType} and wr.Wr_State=7 order by wr.Wr_State_Time desc limit 1

select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, wr.Wr_Title as wrTitle, proc.C_Name as pConsName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, mn.* from OA_Project_Report mn left join OA_Work_Report wr on wr.Wr_Id = mn.Wr_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department where mn.Pr_Id = #{prId}
select sum(Pr_Complete_Inv) as prCompleteInvSum, sum(Pr_Year_Inv) as prYearInvSum, sum(Pr_Month_Inv) as prMonthInvSum from OA_Project_Report where Wr_Id = #{wrId}

select wr.Wr_Quarter as wrQuarter, mn.* from OA_Project_Report mn left join OA_Work_Report wr on wr.Wr_Id=mn.Wr_Id where mn.Pr_Type='03' and wr.Wr_Year = #{year} and wr.Wr_State=7 and mn.P_Id in
#{pId}

select mn.* from OA_Project_Report mn left join OA_Work_Report wr on wr.Wr_Id=mn.Wr_Id where mn.Pr_Type='02' and to_char(wr.Wr_Date,'yyyy-MM') = concat(#{year},'-',#{month}) and wr.Wr_State=7 and mn.P_Id in
#{pId}

select mn.* from OA_Project_Report mn left join OA_Work_Report wr on wr.Wr_Id=mn.Wr_Id where mn.Pr_Type='02' and date_format(wr.Wr_Date,'%Y-%m') = concat(#{year},'-',#{month}) and wr.Wr_State=7 and mn.P_Id in
#{pId}

select mn.* from OA_Project_Report mn left join OA_Work_Report wr on wr.Wr_Id=mn.Wr_Id where mn.Pr_Type='02' and to_char(wr.Wr_Date,'yyyy-MM') = concat(#{year},'-',#{month}) and wr.Wr_State=7 and mn.P_Id in
#{pId}
